title: Primer of the Hand Hatchet
summary: Teaches a first-time student to draw, grip, chop and lob the light hand axe at short range.

title: Drill-Book of the Throwing Stump
summary: Sets out repeated chopping and throwing drills against a practice stump so a beginner learns edge-first accuracy.

title: Handbook of the Belt Axe
summary: Covers drawing the carried axe and using its edge, beard and toss in close, hurried fights.

title: Workbook of Haft and Wrist
summary: Trains the sliding grip, wrist roll and release of the hatchet through exercises for students with conditioned tendons.

title: Short Course in Light Axe Fighting
summary: Shows hardened students how to use hatchet, beard and poll in clinches and at a distance.

title: Beginner's Canon of the Thrown Hatchet
summary: Introduces a newly circulating student to steadying grip, throw and parry with a thread of qi.

title: Lessons in Spin and Release
summary: Teaches counting the axe's turns by distance and varying the arc of a throw from high to flat.

title: Treatise on the Hooked Beard and Poll
summary: Explains hooking, pulling and hammering with the beard and poll of the axe, lightly charged with qi.

title: Course of the Throw and Retrieval Step
summary: Drills the throw, the recovery of the axe and the footwork that joins them for a student with working qi.

title: Handbook of the Skirmisher's Axe
summary: Gives a circulating student moving throws, flank darts and quick guards for fighting while on the move.
